evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 down from ~28770 ppm to 15 ppm; it has stayed at 3-6 ppm since.
Thermocouple followed the ramp setpoint to within about 0.5 °C.
Overshot to 761.4 °C when growth began, then settled to 752.5 °C against the 750 °C setpoint. This fits normal controller settling.
Heater power dropped from 84.5% to about 41% once the ramp ended and the hold began. This fits the controller holding temperature and agrees with the thermocouple.
Argon flow is steady at 100 sccm and pressure at about 760 Torr, so no sign of a leak or blocked exhaust.
